name: Idea Chain
description: A 4-round telephone game built with the Idea Chain recipe.

intro.message:
Idea Chain

Everyone writes one idea to start. Then for 4 rounds, the idea passes to the next person, who reads the latest version and transforms it.

At the end, your own idea comes back to you, and you'll see every step it took.

starter.prompt: Write one character: a name, an age, and one detail that makes them distinctive.

round-1.prompt:
The version you received:

“{{starter.assigned}}”

Rewrite the version you received with one twist: change the setting, the mood, or what happens next.

round-2.prompt:
The version you received:

“{{round-1.assigned}}”

Rewrite the version you received with one twist: change the setting, the mood, or what happens next.

round-3.prompt:
The version you received:

“{{round-2.assigned}}”

Rewrite the version you received with one twist: change the setting, the mood, or what happens next.

round-4.prompt:
The version you received:

“{{round-3.assigned}}”

Rewrite the version you received with one twist: change the setting, the mood, or what happens next.

evolved.content: Everyone is reading how their own idea changed, hand to hand.

gallery.message: Every chain, start to finish. Read each one out loud.

end.message: Look how far each idea travelled from where it started!
